starters.title: Animal-health status register
starters.task: This starter records a dated compliance assessment and the related externally issued health certification for an animal, animal group, or agricultural facility. It stores the certification's recorded status and validity dates as separate facts. The record-health-certification-status Action records a later source assertion on the same certification while the Base Registry Engine history retains the earlier values. It changes only the recorded status, source-effective date and opaque source reference; the certified subject, authority, scheme, scope, assessment and validity period remain unchanged.
starters.summary: Dated animal-health assessments and externally issued certifications.

recordTypes.description: One dated assessment against stated requirements.

recordTypes.label: Health certification

actions.label: Record health certification
actions.description: Atomically record an external assessment and certification.

actions.label: Record health certification status
actions.description: Record a later status assertion supplied by the authoritative source.

starters.title: Companion animals and keepers
starters.task: This starter supports a small administrative task: record a contact-responsible person, register a companion animal with one 15-digit microchip assignment and first keeper-responsibility period, then record a later keeper handoff without losing the earlier period. The registrar supplies those facts from its external registration or handoff process. The Base Registry Engine records them together, in one step; it does not decide whether the person is an owner, verify identity or contact details, inspect an implanted chip, or establish the legal effect of a handoff.
starters.summary: Companion animals, recorded microchips and keeper-responsibility periods.

It does not assess eligibility, calculate benefits, or disclose household profiles. Beneficiary and decision URIs remain external references.

starters.task: Record radioactive material sources, radiation permits, radon sites and assessments, and supplied occupational dose results. The starter records decisions and measurements made outside BReg. It does not issue permits, interpret medical risk, recommend remediation, or adjudicate dose limits.

recordTypes.description: Records a supplied radon measurement for one local site.

recordTypes.description: Records a supplied occupational monitoring result without medical interpretation.
